Validate the API URL from Env when a Clincoo Project Boots

An empty string or localhost in production breaks fetch. Check URL shape before the app runs.

This article is available in: Indonesia · English

Many Clincoo projects read API_URL and fetch immediately. If the value is empty, the browser hits a relative path that 404s. If it is http://localhost, production calls the visitor’s machine.

At boot, construct a URL with the URL constructor. If it throws, show the expected variable name. Reject non-https schemes in production.

Do not mix this check with printing secrets. Log only the parsed host. A token in an env URL is still a secret.

Document the shape in .env.example: API_URL=https://api.example.test with no credentials. New teammates copy that form instead of guessing.

Failing fast at startup is cheaper than a form that “sends” to an empty endpoint. Clincoo runs the scripts you save; env checks are the first fence.
